description: Everything waiting on the user across their Chief projects: open manager tasks (decisions, reviews, manual actions), proposed milestones awaiting approval, and stalled work. Call this when the user asks what needs them. The relay block reports whether the user's Chief relay is online; when it isn't, user_options lists what the user can do to start or set it up.

project.description: Optional project id or exact name, to limit the answer to one project.

name: whats_waiting
title: What's waiting on me
